mission.actual: Express app with three routes and no endpoint tests.
mission.gap: README claims a REST API; no OpenAPI document and no route-level tests exist.

dependencies.name: express
dependencies.notes: Major version behind; 5.x is the current line.

architecture.finding: Route handlers talk to the DB directly; no repository layer.

performance.finding: Queries are indexed; no N+1 observed.

documentation.finding: No AGENTS.md; README setup steps fail on Node 22.

optimality.algorithm: O(n) scan per request is acceptable at current volume.
alternatives: Use a validation middleware rather than hand-rolled checks.
optimality.scalability: Holds to ~4x current load; DB pool is the limit.

agentFiles.notes: Build/test commands only exist in CI YAML.

recommendations.title: Add schema validation to POST /orders
recommendations.why: Unvalidated input is the only reachable attack surface in this service.
recommendations.what: Introduce zod validation middleware on the route and reject with 422 on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /orders with a missing field returns 422
recommendations.successMetric: 0 unvalidated request bodies reach the handler
